description: Deletes a project. The last project of an account cannot be deleted (409) — it is where records created without a project go. A project that still holds monitors or status pages needs `move_to_project_id`, otherwise the call returns 409: content moves, settings do not. The notification rules, channel switches and webhook subscriptions of the deleted project are gone for good, and the moved monitors start living by the rules of the destination project — their alerts may end up in a different channel.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

move_to_project_id.description: Where to move the monitors and status pages of the deleted project. Required when it is not empty.

name: project_delete
title: Delete project
